name: authstack-starter
description: Authentication starter with a NestJS API, a Next.js web app, and configurable sign-in, account, session and permission management

scripts.test: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present run test && pnpm run test:config
scripts.check: pnpm run check:bans && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.test:config: node --test scripts/config-transforms-tests/config-transforms.test.mjs scripts/config-transforms-tests/config-transforms.ports.test.mjs scripts/config-transforms-tests/config-transforms.probes.test.mjs scripts/config-transforms-tests/config-transforms.cli.test.mjs scripts/config-transforms-tests/config-transforms.passkeys.test.mjs nginx/render-native-link-host.test.mjs scripts/guardrails/*/*.test.mjs scripts/check-backend-build.test.mjs scripts/workspace-dependencies.test.mjs scripts/ci/*.test.mjs backend/test/run-jest-support.test.mjs backend/test/postgres/server/postgres-orphans.test.mjs && node scripts/check-package-manager.mjs
scripts.test:config:all: node --test scripts/config-transforms-tests/config-transforms.test.mjs scripts/config-transforms-tests/config-transforms.ports.test.mjs scripts/config-transforms-tests/config-transforms.probes.test.mjs scripts/config-transforms-tests/config-transforms.cli.test.mjs scripts/config-transforms-tests/config-transforms.passkeys.test.mjs nginx/render-native-link-host.test.mjs scripts/guardrails/*/*.test.mjs scripts/guardrails/*/*.slow.mjs scripts/check-backend-build.test.mjs scripts/workspace-dependencies.test.mjs scripts/ci/*.test.mjs backend/test/run-jest-support.test.mjs backend/test/postgres/server/postgres-orphans.test.mjs && node scripts/check-package-manager.mjs
